# Windowed live-patch smoke fixtures

These source fixtures are repository-owned acceptance inputs for seq-03.7. The
Rust generator constructs equivalent typed runtime plans from these sources,
embeds the source text in real AWFB bundles, then emits patch AWFB artifacts and
JSON smoke reports in one deterministic pass.

Generated binary files live under `generated/` and are refreshed by:

```bash
cargo +nightly -Zscript tools/regenerate-windowed-live-patch-fixtures.rs --apply
```

The default generator mode is `--check`; it compares the working tree with the
expected generated bytes and exits non-zero when stale artifacts are detected.
